texts.title_text: French train derailment injures 44, authorities probe sabotage
texts.slide_1_text: A passenger train derailed in northern France, injuring 44, including a critical 18-year-old woman.
texts.slide_2_text: Authorities found a piece of rail on the track, raising suspicions of a malicious act.
texts.slide_3_text: Firefighters and medical teams responded to the crash near Renault's factory in Cleon.
texts.slide_4_text: Investigations continue as SNCF reports significant disruptions to rail traffic, with services resuming after emergency operations.
